name: bld2_nonexpanding_left_inverse_isometry
statement: {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f g : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ dist x y) (hfg : ∀ x : X, f (g x) = x) : Isometry g ∧ ∀ x : X, g (f x) = x
closed: ∀ {X : Type*} [MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f g : X → X) (hf : ∀ x y : X, dist (f x) (f y) ≤ dist x y) (hfg : ∀ x : X, f (g x) = x), Isometry g ∧ ∀ x : X, g (f x) = x
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld_surjective_nonexpanding_compact_isometry: f is surjective (right inverse g) and non-expanding, hence an isometry, hence injective; so g (f x) = x from f (g (f x)) = f x, and dist (g x) (g y) = dist (f (g x)) (f (g y)) = dist x y.
type: ∀ {X : Type u_1} [inst : MetricSpace X] [CompactSpace X] (f g : X → X), (∀ (x y : X), dist (f x) (f y) ≤ dist x y) → (∀ (x : X), f (g x) = x) → Isometry g ∧ ∀ (x : X), g (f x) = x
